_comment: The builds run under Bazel (--bazel among the tools/gn flags; flutter/build/bazel/ci.md), and each
lints itself: ci/clang_tidy.sh, run as the build's own test step, makes the compile database from the
build's action graph (tools/gn_to_bazel/tool/compile_commands.py: bazel aquery over the build's
configuration, the generated headers fetched) and runs the lint over all of it. The database names
the drone's own execution root, so the lint cannot move to tester drones over a CAS archive of the
build directory as GN's four host shards did; one 32-core drone a build lints the whole variant
instead (no --shard-id/--shard-variants), and the Android build lints every file of its own database
rather than its share of the host's intersection.

builds.name: ci/android_debug_arm64_clang_tidy
builds.description: A debug mode arm64 Android build used only as the basis for a clang-tidy run, which runs as its test step.

builds.name: ci/host_debug_clang_tidy
builds.description: A debug mode Linux host build used only as the basis for a clang-tidy run, which runs as its test step.
